units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:3">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵃ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="G00008"><he>זב</he></cite>, <cite ref="II Samuel 3:29">II Sam. III, 29</cite>) <cite ref="V01089"><he>תָּשִׁישׁ</he></cite> q. v.

Zab. I, 5 זב גמור a real zabh (subject to all the laws in Lev. XV, 1—15; 19—24). Ib. V, 6; a. v. fr.—Pl. זָבִים, זָבִין; f. זָבוֹת. Sifra Metsora, Zabim, Par. 1 מטמאים כז׳ (not בז׳) they make unclean like Israelitish zabim; Nidd. 34ᵃ שיהו כז׳ וכ׳; a. v. fr. [Sabb. 110ᵇ מזביך, v. זוֹב.]—Zabim, name of a treatise of the Mishnah a. Tosefta, and of a section of the Sifra to Metsora.
